path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, relative to path, e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'. A pattern without '/' matches file names at any depth

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

content.text: {"head":"cd3843165060ffbd9115dbe431ce306f8759af15","verdict":"findings","coverage":["internal/app/decisions.go","internal/app/review_actions.go","internal/app/review_cap.go","internal/app/review_cap_regression_test.go","internal/app/review_rounds_test.go","internal/e2e/review_cap_workspace_test.go","internal/e2e/review_carry_refresh_test.go","internal/e2e/review_validation_actions_test.go","internal/e2e/staging_validation_test.go","internal/store/ci_validation_test.go","internal/store/greenhouse_verdicts_test.go","internal/store/review_rounds.go","internal/store/validation_state.go","internal/store/validation_state_test.go"],"findings":[{"id":"ignored, computed by controller","priority":"P1","origin":"correctness","file":"internal/app/review_cap.go","start":26,"end":30,"explanation":"For full-pipeline Tasks, changing the cap usage to `RepairRounds` makes the existing `checkReviewCapAfterReviewDone` path raise a `review_cap` notice for every non-pass Review verdict once the blocking-repair count reaches the cap, including a changes_requested verdict containing only non-blocking findings. `queueReviewFix` then refuses that non-blocking-only repair, so an ordinary non-blocking review outcome is incorrectly routed into a cap Decision despite not consuming the cap.","action":"Only raise the cap notice after a non-pass verdict when the verdict has at least one actionable blocking finding (or otherwise distinguish a repair-required blocking outcome); non-blocking findings should follow the normal disposition/follow-up path without a review-cap Decision.","rule":"","head":"cd3843165060ffbd9115dbe431ce306f8759af15"}]}
